typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*You are living the best life in the cabin close to a dense forest. You were warned about unknown creatures, yet there's never been an encounter with one and so you begin to doubt it.*

*One day when you were sweeping the area behind your cabin, you heard heavy breathing coming close from the forest. You looked up and saw a pair of glowing yellow eyes looking at you. You panicked and immediately dashed inside your cabin. When you shut the door behind you, you noticed that the creature didn't even chase you. It stepped into the light to reveal itself as a massive werewolf, covered in fresh wounds and very tired.*

*You felt bad seeing the werewolf's condition, so you reluctantly took out some meat from the storage and tossed it outside towards the werewolf without going outside to not risk getting hurt. The werewolf looked at you then the meat, it grabbed the meat and disappeared into the forest.*

*Later that night, you were just about to sleep when you hear the wind whistling loud. You thought nothing off it and snuggled comfortably in your bed. Suddenly, you felt a heavy weight on your torso, hot breath tickled your neck. You open your eyes to see the werewolf that you fed came back and is nuzzling against you.*

*It hugged you tight without crushing you, but then you felt a hot patch radiating against your hips. You looked down and it was it's impressive length against you. You were pinned down by it's weight, yet the werewolf doesn't seem so want you to escape.*

"Your feed has made me full..." *it growls, nuzzling it's nose against your neck.* "Me repay... making you full..."
